mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_course c JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id WHERE e.student_id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND e.active=1 AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED')
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_name AS username,nick_name AS name FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{studentId} AND

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mentor_note(mentor_id,student_id,content) SELECT #{mentorId},#{studentId},#{content} FROM DUAL WHERE
mapper.update: UPDATE mentor_note SET content=#{content},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND version=#{version} AND
